_comment: Foci Karma multipliers (SR4A p.200). Bonded Karma = Force x multiplier. Limits: bonded foci <= Magic; total bonded Force <= Magic x5; active foci <= Logic; only one focus adds Force per pool; Focus Addiction test (DG) if active Force > 2 x Magic. Descriptions of some entries are summaries; verify against supplements/magic/ files before relying on them.
